jobs.title: Senior Portfolio Manager
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
Senior HCM Portfolio Lead / Manager - Technology

Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates | Contract | 12+ years of experience

Primary platform: Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM

Overview

Own the strategy, delivery and operational performance of an enterprise HCM technology portfolio. As the principal technology partner to People & Organisation (P&O), you will translate workforce priorities into a practical roadmap and reliable services, from shaping demand through to adoption and measurable business value after go-live.

Responsibilities

Build and maintain the annual HCM technology roadmap, with clear priorities, dependencies, investment needs and expected outcomes
Partner with senior P&O leaders and HR process owners on process design, standard platform capabilities and justified changes
Lead programmes, projects, enhancements, integrations and releases across the employee lifecycle
Oversee solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, adoption and transition into support
Govern architecture, integrations, data quality, reporting, security, access controls and compliance
Own live service health, including critical HR and payroll activities, service levels, incidents, recurring problems and release readiness
Lead cross-functional teams and implementation partners; manage capacity, dependencies and budgets
Report clearly on progress, risks, service health, spend and realised benefits, and drive continuous improvement

Required experience

12+ years of experience, with substantial leadership of an enterprise HCM technology portfolio or large-scale HCM transformation in a complex, multi-entity organisation
Strong HCM business-process knowledge and confidence discussing policy, controls and user impact with senior P&O leaders
Deep enterprise HCM or ERP experience covering solution governance, integrations, data, security, testing, releases and live operations
Proven ownership spanning both new delivery and ongoing service performance
Experience managing cross-functional teams, partners, budgets and senior stakeholder expectations
Strong judgement, executive communication and the ability to turn ambiguous needs into a practical roadmap

Nice to have

Hands-on leadership with Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM or another leading ERP
Experience across payroll, time and absence, talent, recruitment, learning, analytics and HCM
integrations
Experience in healthcare or another large, regulated, operationally complex environment

Why apply

This role offers end-to-end ownership of the HCM technology portfolio and close partnership with senior P&O leadership. Your work will support reliable critical services and measurable improvements in efficiency, control and employee experience.

Apply

Send your CV and availability to andrew.smith@tanint.com, using Senior HCM Portfolio Manager as the subject.
